frontmatter.description: Actual imaginary-time Pauli LCU on a Bell purification, with explicit postselection and separate energy groups.

children.value: This bounded example implements a noncommuting imaginary-time Taylor filter with actual PREPARE/SELECT/unprepare access. Its conditional purification and reduced thermal state are checked against independent matrix-polynomial and Gibbs references. Full reset/readout attempts and capped retries are counted. The separate

wraps this actual preparation and preserves its accepted purification. A conditional physical-resource study below supplies actual Clifford+T compilation for the unamplified degree-6 X/Z task. Classical Pauli aggregation can be exponential; unrestricted Gibbs methods, certified synthesis and hardware calibration remain planned.

It avoids this example’s Pauli-power aggregation, while retaining bounded phase generation and materialization limits. Its interval and numerical realization contracts are stated separately; unrestricted Gibbs preparation remains planned.

children.value: . Eight complete attempts suffice for at least one accepted measured output with 99% ideal acceptance confidence. The attempts include fresh system/reference/label resets, Bell preparation, actual access/uncomputation, label measurement, unconditioned reference reset, basis changes and system readout. Every branch runs the whole schedule; failed measured trials are discarded afterward. No early-abort saving or amplitude amplification is claimed.

The default Z attempt lowers to 21 CX, 8 RZ, 7 RY, 6 X, 6 T, 6 T-dagger and 2 H gates, plus 5 resets and 3 measurements. The X attempt has its actual final H-basis change and different lowered counts. These original logical exports retain unsynthesized continuous-angle rotations. Native T/T-dagger instructions are counted separately from arbitrary rotations; their presence does not certify the rest of the circuit.
